title: [Bug]  Claude codes terminal instance keep shutting down after some time even when reprompting
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude codes terminal instances keep shutting down silently they dont continue working on their tasks since yesterday after a while (a few minutes to 30minutes) 
the only solution for now is starting a new instance and use /resume

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 2.0.60
- Feedback ID: 8071aa99-10e3-412a-8c5d-a244d0cb4aea
